title: Languages and wording
description: Change the words of the app for your people, or translate it into another language. Texts you do not change keep coming from the level above.
partner_description: Wording you set here applies to all of your clients. Clients may change it further only if you allow it.
platform_description: Languages of the platform and the platform's own wording. A new language starts as a draft and is offered once enough of it is translated.
search_placeholder: Search by English, current text or key
reset_text: Your wording for this text is removed. People see what the level above (or the app) says.
unknown_placeholders: Not in the original: {names}. Use only {allowed}.
markup: Remove anything between < and >: texts are plain.
read_only: You can look but not change wording here.
own_wording_off: Own wording is off here: the Multi-language module is off, or your provider keeps one wording for all clients.
wrong_level: Wording is set for a group or a company. Switch to your company to change it.
import_text: Texts from the file replace your wording for the same keys in {language}. Empty texts are skipped. If one text is not accepted, nothing is saved.
import_empty: The file has no texts to import.
bad_file: This file could not be read. Use a CSV exported here, or a JSON file of texts.
bad_columns: The CSV needs a "key" column and a "text" or "own" column.
code_hint: For example hi (Hindi), ar (Arabic), ur (Urdu), pt-BR.
name: Name in the language itself
remove_text: The draft and all of its texts are removed. This cannot be undone.
disable_text: People using it see the default language instead. Its texts are kept and it can be offered again.
